# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/calendar.mjs, docs/design/calendar_localisation.md). Do not edit; change tools/content/data/world/reckonings.json or pantheon.json.
# zin_reckoning_refresh (country scope): sets zin_reckoning_month, zin_reckoning_year, zin_reckoning_mod100, zin_reckoning_units and zin_reckoning_tens
# for the current date in the scope country's reckoning, which [This.zin_reckoning_date] then writes. Call it in the immediate block of an event
# (or before any text that shows the date); it changes no game state.
zin_reckoning_refresh = {
	# The month of the current date (1-12): the last month whose first day has come.
	set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 1 }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].2.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].3.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].4.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].5.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].6.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].7.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].8.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].9.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].10.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].11.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 11 } }
	if = { limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { NOT = { date < [Y].12.1 } } Y = "[?global.year|0]" } } set_variable = { zin_reckoning_month = 12 } }
	# The local year: the 4A year, an era year (the Wells, the Ledger) or the Rising of the reign (0 before the first Rising or when it is not known).
	set_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = global.year }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_calendar_well_count }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_reckoning_offset = constant:zin_calendar.well_count_offset }
		add_to_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = zin_reckoning_offset }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_calendar_ledger_count }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_reckoning_offset = constant:zin_calendar.ledger_count_offset }
		add_to_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = zin_reckoning_offset }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_calendar_flood_count }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zin_reckoning_first_rising }
			subtract_from_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = zin_reckoning_first_rising }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_reckoning_rising = constant:zin_calendar.rising_month }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { zin_reckoning_month < zin_reckoning_rising } } } add_to_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = 1 } }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_reckoning_year min = 0 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { zin_reckoning_year = 0 } }
	}
	# The digits the ordinal texts read.
	set_variable = { zin_reckoning_mod100 = zin_reckoning_year }
	modulo_variable = { var = zin_reckoning_mod100 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { zin_reckoning_units = zin_reckoning_year }
	modulo_variable = { var = zin_reckoning_units value = 10 }
	set_variable = { zin_reckoning_tens = zin_reckoning_mod100 }
	subtract_from_variable = { zin_reckoning_tens = zin_reckoning_units }
	divide_variable = { zin_reckoning_tens = 10 }
}

# zin_reckoning_new_reign (country scope): a river-king of the Count of the Floods begins his reign. He is crowned standing in the Rising: his first
# Rising is this year's until the month of the Rising has passed, otherwise next year's. Call it where a flood_count realm gets a new leader.
zin_reckoning_new_reign = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_calendar_flood_count }
		zin_reckoning_refresh = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_reckoning_rising = constant:zin_calendar.rising_month }
		set_variable = { zin_reckoning_first_rising = global.year }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { zin_reckoning_month > zin_reckoning_rising } } add_to_variable = { zin_reckoning_first_rising = 1 } }
		zin_reckoning_refresh = yes
	}
}
